_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture for the Omega-J Home 2024 line (ADR 30). Built from the Basecamp AUG2 screenshots — this is NOT a captured response. Per ADR 30 R1 the real <Option> payload shape, the placement of ContractType, and whether the M2M plans also carry the 999999 mileage sentinel are all UNVERIFIED. Capture a real AUG2 GetRates through the /se-rating proxy and add a regression test in that exact shape before Phase 2. Per ADR 30 R6 the prices here are ILLUSTRATIVE: plan base prices come from the published table, add-on prices are transcribed from a screenshot, and the 12-month P/E add-on rows are derived (no plan offers a P/E variant at 12 months, so they are never resolved).

filters._note: Home has no mileage axis. The term list is the union across plans — 36 and 37 have no 12-month option.

_add_ons_note: Home add-ons are per-product `options[]`, not a flat catalog: identity and price depend on plan code AND term. See packages/utils/home-addons.js.
